A trunk-only build simply stops mentioning the unpushed row: the loss is identical and nothing is left to notice. So main() now REFUSES (exit 3) when the working tree carries ledger rows or receipts origin/main does not, and names the remedy — one commit. `--allow-divergence` emits anyway with the lost ids printed into the prompt, for a builder that genuinely cannot commit.
